fact: The World Bank's completion report dated 28 February 2025 is catalogued as stating that the project MIS held a data-sharing platform linked to the National Civil Registry via API and to payment providers, but the captured text stops before that narrative, so the date used is the report's published date.

The record states the Sudan Family Support Project, approved 8 October 2020 and closed 30 June 2024 with US$181.4 million disbursed of US$760 million committed, had an MIS with a data-sharing platform linked to the National Civil Registry via API and to payment providers; the date used is the approval date, given as the record's published date.
